scan_metadata.scan_scope: packages/ directory (excluding test assets and browser patches)
scan_metadata.notes: Flags are environment variables acting as feature gates in the Playwright source code. PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_* and PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_* configuration env vars were excluded as they are standard documented config options, not feature flags. PWTEST_* test infrastructure flags for paths/timeouts/names (PWTEST_FORCE_EXIT_TIMEOUT, PWTEST_PROFILE_DIR, PWTEST_CLI_HEADLESS, etc.) were excluded as they are pure config overrides rather than feature gates.
